title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(下川雄一研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Shimokawa Yuichi)
keywords: Architectural planning and design 2.Production 3.BIM and xR 4.Design Science 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students choose either "work" or "thesis" as the framework for their activities, with the following goals: (1)In case of "work": Students should propose architectural design with high originality and reasonable logic as "works" based on architectural programming. (2)In the case of "thesis": Students propose and verify new application methods of technologies such as BIM and xR for architectural design and production, and present them as "thesis".
advice: 1) Students should execute project activities as follows; In case of "works"; studying theme, investigating architectural works, books, sites, etc., making concepts, planning and schematic design In case of "thesis"; studying theme, survey of relevant published paper, making concepts, practice & application and analysis of results 2) Students must have a interim presentation and receive evaluation. 3) Students must create of a final report as follows; In case of "work": organizing the final design proposal and creating drawings and models In case of "thesis": organizing the process of research and writing the thesis 4) Students must give a presentation at the public presentation review of Design Project III, where they must be evaluated and passed.
books: Textbooks:Specify according to theme Reference books:Specify according to theme Reserved books:Specify according to theme
requiredKnowledge: Design Project III is a synthesis of various knowledge, skills and sensibilities. Based on the knowledge and skills learned in individual classes and extracurricular activities, as well as on your own experiences and feelings, it is important to work on essential problem solving while further improving knowledge and skills and deepening considerations.

activityGoals.body: Students can set goals and activity plans for their own themes, conduct surveys and collect materials.
Students can consider better architecture and environment and make specific proposals and activities.
Students can make proposals and activities that apply BIM technologies to architectural planning and design.
Students can organize the process and results of their activities and create a project report(work/thesis).
Students can give a presentation about the results and key points of the project simply.
Students can consider the project theme associating their own courses after graduation.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey based on an awareness of the project problem, and are able to explain not only the problem as a research theme but also the necessity of solving it. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves, and effectively carry out the project according to their plan. They can produce a logical report/ an attractive work of the results and give an effective presentation of the findings to others.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain their own awareness of the issues and collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves and carry out the project. They can create a thesis/a work as a outcome and give a presentation of their findings for others.

lessons.content: Instructions for developing the project theme. Explanation of topics of relating research themes. Report on the progress of students' research. Report on the literature search.
lessons.assignments: Review: Confirmation of the topics. Incorporation of suggestions. Preparation: Conduct the research.

lessons.content: Report on the progress of students'research.
